title: Microsoft Purview: recurring classifier refresh for existing content
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap targets and documented on-demand scan controls are supported, and it distinguishes those controls from the planned recurring refresh. Minor corrections should qualify the classifier-selection discussion, cite the endpoint policy documentation, and remove checklist instructions for controls absent from the table.
